parameters.jsCode: const ctx = $('Conversation').item.json; const cookies = $json.headers['set-cookie']; const list = Array.isArray(cookies) ? cookies : [cookies || '']; const cookie = list.map(x=>x.split(';')[0]).find(x=>x.startsWith('access_token=')); if (!cookie) throw new Error('Login did not return access_token cookie'); return {json:{...ctx,cookie}};

const ctx = $('Extract session').item.json; if (!$json.id) throw new Error('Missing appointment id'); const s = $getWorkflowStaticData('global').sessions[ctx.key]; s.step='done'; s.appointmentId=$json.id; const body = ctx.emergency ? 'Your urgent request has been added to our clinic team queue. Please call the clinic now: +' + ctx.cfg.staffPhone + '. Do not wait for a WhatsApp reply.' : 'Request received! Our clinic team will confirm your preferred time on WhatsApp. Reply RESCHEDULE or CANCEL anytime to contact the team.'; return {json:{...ctx,payload:{messaging_product:'whatsapp',to:ctx.to,type:'text',text:{body}}}};
